title: Ada bar Gershon
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 10:6](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Terumot.10.6.8): “Rabbi Ze’irah, Ada bar Gershon, Rabbi Burai, Rabbi Levi bar Palta,” etc. This statement is cited in [Chullin 98a](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.98a.9) by Rav Shaman bar Abba in the name of Rav Idi bar Idi bar Gershom, who said it in the name of Levi bar Parta, etc.[^1]

notes.text: The Yerushalmi names Ada bar Gershon and Rabbi Levi bar Palta. The linked Bavli names Rav Idi bar Idi bar Gershom and Levi bar Parta, and continues through Rabbi Nachum and Rabbi Biryam. [Heilprin’s Ada entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=232&lang=en) directs readers to Idi. The names, transmitters and numerical rulings differ across the accounts.
